reason: The hypothesis directly restates the intervention (Y and Hf co-doping) and the observed outcomes (improved thermal stability, reduced grain growth, better oxide scale adhesion) from P2, which already demonstrated these effects in laser-clad coatings of the same alloy. The proposed mechanism of grain/phase boundary stabilization is also suggested in P2 and P34. The hypothesis merely extends the application from coatings to bulk material and adds creep testing, which is a minor, obvious next step rather than a novel synthesis or transfer.
